content:
- run: |
    python3 <<EOF
    import json, re, sys
    with open('$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH') as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    pr = data['pull_request']
    title = pr.get('title', '')
    body = pr.get('body', '') or ''
    if re.search(r'#\d+', title) or re.search(r'#\d+', body):
        sys.exit(0)
    else:
        sys.exit(1)
    EOF
